verdict.rationale: Browser-based session access is a fair axis for a remote-desktop product, but no evidence item documents a TeamViewer web client for viewing or controlling a session with nothing installed. Community reports point the other way: the get.teamviewer.com invitation page launches the installed app via a protocol handler or prompts a download, and Mac users report having to install the app just to control another desktop.

support.subject: As a power user, someone can view or control a session from a plain browser with nothing installed
